plan.title: 25 VS Code Productivity Tips and Speed Hacks
plan.summary: A chaptered rundown of 25 VS Code shortcuts, settings, and extensions for writing code faster, from the command palette to GitLens and remote repositories.

moves.title: Install VS Code
moves.intent: Get VS Code set up as your editor so the rest of the tips in the video have somewhere to land.

moves.title: Turn on Remote Repositories
moves.intent: Browse and edit a GitHub repo directly in VS Code without cloning it locally, using the Remote Repositories feature.

moves.title: Go find and try the GitLens extension
moves.intent: Search the VS Code marketplace for the GitLens extension named in the video and try it for inline git blame and history.

moves.title: Work through all 25 tips
moves.intent: Go chapter by chapter through the video and fold each of the 25 shortcuts, settings, and extensions into daily VS Code use.
moves.evidence: Learn 25 VS Code tips and tricks that will help you write code faster.
